text:
maria: Heads-up — release blocked by a regen diff in typegen after the auth/retry changes. publish pipeline aborted. anyone on this?
ci-bot: publish pipeline #789 failed on step `verify-typegen`
ci-bot: "TypeGen mismatch detected. Run `make typegen-regen` and commit diffs."
ci-bot: log: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/789 (permissions)
samir: I saw this locally — retry semantics were changed from `max_retries` to `max_attempts` in the OpenAPI comments which shifted generated names. tiny but breaks SDK parity.
jon: if the runtime accepts both aliases it's not a runtime break, but generated client surface changed. that's a semver-minor, right? not patch.
lee: sample-apps/python fails its tests because the auth decorator signature changed. simple fix but needs updated sample & changelog entry.
maria: release-bot is blocking the release until typegen diffs are committed per policy. is there a quick workaround to keep hosted publish going?
release-bot: Release hold applied: reason=typegen_regen_diff, ticket=#INFRA-2345, owner=<none> :hourglass: 
ops-bot: You can opt to pin the published SDKs to the previous spec with `model:schema:v1` routing, but that's a manual workaround and not recommended.
samir: proposed options:
- revert the OpenAPI comment change (fast) -> publish patch
- accept surface change -> bump minor, update changelogs & sample apps (clean)
- special-case codegen to map names (ugly)
I'm leaning toward bumping minor and documenting the auth change in changelog.
jon: agree with samir. this is an observable API surface change for SDK users. publish notes should explain migration (search/replace `max_retries` -> `max_attempts`).
lee: I'll open a PR against sample-apps to update the auth usage and add a quick test. assigning to self.
maria: can someone run `make typegen-regen` and paste the diff? I want to see the exact lines.
samir: pasted diff snippet:
```diff
-  retry: { max_retries: 2 }
+  retry: { max_attempts: 3 }
```
samir: also noticed Python type hints changed: `Optional[int]` -> `int | None` in py3.10+ generator. that might be surprising to some users.
jon: oh that explains one of the test failures in python sample app. we should add a small note in changelog about py version and type hints.
release-bot: NOTE: changelog entry required for minor bumps. use `changelog/announce.md` template.
maria: ok plan: samir will open the typegen PR with the regen diff and changelog draft; lee will update sample-apps; jon will draft migration blurb; I'll coordinate release timeline. if we agree, I'll remove the release hold.
lee: working on sample-apps PR now. will link when ready.
samir: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/456 — includes regen, tests updated, changelog draft. CI still failing on one go-sdk lint.
ci-bot: go-sdk lint error: `golangci-lint: field name changed: RetryMax -> RetryAttempts`
jon: adding backward-compat shim in go-sdk to support both field names for one release, then remove in next minor. that should unblock CI quickly.
maria: thanks all. @here if anyone depends on SDKs this week expect a minor bump and a short migration note. I'll update the release issue. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Release hold cleared by maria — reason=owner_assigned
maria: final: set release window to next thursday so we can get all sample apps and changelogs in.
